scoring_justification: Checker recomputes peak location, log–log slope of MR vs B, and FWHM monotonicity from the raw two-band simulation CSV – all structural invariants that are independent of the agent's chosen parameter values.

outputs.description: Magnetoresistance resonance data: longitudinal resistivity or MR as a function of magnetic field B and compensation ratio p/n.

output_contract.notes: The simulation demonstrates the resonance peak at p/n=1 and the B² trend at exact compensation. All parameter choices (densities, mobilities) are representative; the scoring checks structural features (peak position, quadratic slope, width narrowing) independent of specific numeric values.

steps.description: Two-band model simulation – derive peak position, log–log slope, and FWHM monotonicity from the submitted CSV.
